exercises.prompt:

先月はテレビを____見ませんでした。
exercises.translation: Insert only あまり (also あんまり) or 全然（ぜんぜん）. Describe the context literally; if it states zero, make the complete denial explicit, not an understatement. Recognized spellings are accepted.
exercises.evidence: Use the complete supplied context and the requested operation, not an unstated fact.
exercises.explanation: Context: I watched television only once last month. Completion: I did not watch television very often last month. The viewing was infrequent, not absent. あまり～ませんでした gives the limited-frequency assessment; literal 全然～ませんでした would erase the stated viewing.

options.label: あまり
options.rationale: Context: I watched television only once last month. Completion: I did not watch television very often last month. The viewing was infrequent, not absent. あまり～ませんでした gives the limited-frequency assessment; literal 全然～ませんでした would erase the stated viewing.

options.label: 全然
options.rationale: A literal complete denial conflicts with the stated nonzero amount or degree. The viewing was infrequent, not absent. あまり～ませんでした gives the limited-frequency assessment; literal 全然～ませんでした would erase the stated viewing.

exercises.explanation: Context: Twenty books were ordered; only one has not arrived, and the others are on the desk. Completion: Almost all the ordered books are on the desk.
